origin.description: Reads JSON from a stream in chunks and returns the last top-level value, or the last callback result.
origin.usage: readJSONStream(con, cb = NULL, simplify = Strict, nullValue = NULL, simplifyWithNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: A connection, or any expression that yields JSON text.

arguments.name: cb
arguments.text: Optional callback for each top-level JSON value in the stream.

origin.details: The parser pulls data in 1024-character reads. Multiple top-level values may appear in one stream; without a callback the last value is returned.
origin.value: The last top-level JSON object, or the last value returned by cb.
origin.example: An array from a file stream, concatenated values where the last object is kept, and a callback that returns length.
